files.needsEngine: {{name}} needs the PSPP engine, which is not available in demo mode. CSV, Excel, ODS, JSON and SPS files work.

saveAs.mockWarning: SPSS formats need the PSPP WebAssembly engine, which is not running. Excel, ODS, CSV, TSV and JSON work without it.

fmtDesc.xlsx: .xlsx – data plus a sheet describing the variables
fmtDesc.ods: .ods – for LibreOffice, data plus variable descriptions
fmtDesc.json: .json – the whole dataset, for PSPP Studio and scripts

io.xlsOld: The old Excel .xls format cannot be read. Save {{name}} in Excel as .xlsx or .csv and open it again.

group.sheets: Spreadsheets and text – for other programs

io.labels: Write value labels instead of codes
io.labelsDesc: E.g. “female” instead of 2. Good for reading, not for further analysis.
io.sheetNote: The second sheet describes the variables: labels, measure, value labels and missing values.

out.title: Export output

fmtDesc.pdf: For printing and handing in, A4 with page numbers
fmtDesc.html: A single .html file for the browser
fmtDesc.docx: An editable .docx with tables and charts

optDesc.toc: A linked list of results at the start of the document
optDesc.interpret: What t-tests, correlations and other tests mean, under their tables
optDesc.syntax: The PSPP commands that produced each result – to repeat the analysis

out.pdfHint: The browser's print dialog opens. Choose “Save as PDF” as the printer.
out.footer: Created with PSPP Studio – free software built on GNU PSPP.
out.savedDocx: Output downloaded as a Word document
